LanguageData.ATK_Asphalt.label: asphalt
LanguageData.ATK_Asphalt.description: A tarry substance produced from chemfuel that makes for a quick-setting surface for roads and outdoor walkways. Not very pretty. Deconstructing asphalt yields no resources.
LanguageData.ATK_DuckboardFloor.label: duckboard floor
LanguageData.ATK_DuckboardFloor.description: A surface consisting of wooden slats joined together, commonly used to form a walkable surface over mud and dirt. Quick to build, extremely flammable and somewhat ugly.
LanguageData.ATK_FineWoodMosaicFloor.label: fine wood mosaic
LanguageData.ATK_FineWoodMosaicFloor.description: Wooden flooring assembled from precisely cut wood to create a beautiful mosaic-style surface. Takes much longer to build and requires more material than normal wood floor but is just as flammable.
LanguageData.ATK_FineWoodPlankFloor.label: fine wood floor
LanguageData.ATK_FineWoodPlankFloor.description: Wooden flooring assembled from precisely cut wood for a more beautiful, patterned appearance. Takes much longer to build and requires more material than normal wood floor but is just as flammable.
LanguageData.ATK_FineWoodTileFloor.label: fine wood tile
LanguageData.ATK_FineWoodTileFloor.description: Wooden flooring assembled from precisely cut wood for a more beautiful, patterned appearance. Takes much longer to build and requires more material than normal wood floor but is just as flammable.
LanguageData.ATK_Lawn.label: lawn
LanguageData.ATK_Lawn.description: Synthetic material derived from chemfuel that has been sculpted to provide the appearance of a freshly-mown grass lawn. Pretty, but extremely flammable.
LanguageData.ATK_SpacerGoldTile.label: spacer gold tile
LanguageData.ATK_SpacerGoldTile.description: Gold tiles, for that spaceship look. They are pretty, and the smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
LanguageData.ATK_SpacerSilverTile.label: spacer silver tile
LanguageData.ATK_SpacerSilverTile.description: Silver tiles, for that spaceship look. They are pretty, and the smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
LanguageData.ATK_SpacerSteelTile.label: spacer steel tile
LanguageData.ATK_SpacerSteelTile.description: Steel tiles, for that spaceship look. They are pretty, and the smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
LanguageData.ATK_SpacerWoodTile.label: spacer wood tile
LanguageData.ATK_SpacerWoodTile.description: Wooden tiles reinforced with steel and treated to be fire-resistant. They are pretty, and the smooth tile surface gets a bonus to cleanliness.
LanguageData.ATK_WoodBrickBondFloor.label: wood brick bond floor
LanguageData.ATK_WoodBrickBondFloor.description: Wood flooring made of short cut planks laid in a staggered pattern for a brick-like appearance. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
LanguageData.ATK_WoodMixedPlankFloor.label: mixed wood floor
LanguageData.ATK_WoodMixedPlankFloor.description: Plank flooring made from mixed types of wood for a warm, rustic feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.
